# Vendored GSAP 3.12.7

`gsap.min.js` is the official GSAP build, copied for **offline labs**. Do not load GSAP from a CDN.

Use it from `code/09-gsap.html`:

```html
<script src="../vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>
```

See the GSAP license at [gsap.com](https://gsap.com) / GreenSock standard license. Three.js lives under `ThreeJS/vendor/` (MIT).
